text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Friday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
ALL NEWSPAPERS
- The leader of Kaunas criminal world Henrikas Daktaras was sentenced for seven and a half years in prison.
LIETUVOS RYTAS
- Lithuanian Presidents Algirdas Brazauskas wants more powers but not one-man rule, he told the newspaper after four years in the office. The next presidential elections are due in December 1997.
- The deputy chairman of parliament's budget and finance comittee resigns in protest at the working style and methods of Elvyra Kineviciene, the head of the comittee.
- Inflation was 2.8 percent in January, statistics department says.
- The news that World Bank supports the wish of Lithuanian government to close problem struck Innovation Bank has caused panic among its depositors.
RESPUBLIKA
- Latvia's parliament approved Andris Shkele's government on Thursday.

- The Lithuanian parliament for the first time took into consideration the suggestion of the president and decided to leave the KGB, Lithuanian Communist Party and interior ministry documents in the hands of the central archives.
- The constitutional court decided that the ban on tobacco and alcohol advertising does not contradict the country's constitution and it will come into effect next week.
LIETUVOS AIDAS
- 620,000 tons of transit metal built up in Klaipeda port and customs officials claims it is not only their fault.
- Enfiroment protection officials fined Elektrenai power plant 314,000 litas for using orimulsion fuel polluting the enviroment without special permission in January.
VERSLO ZINIOS
- The agriculture and forestry ministries halted the privatisation of four sugar refineries. The ministry comission will take a decision on te fate of the companies on February 28.
- A 34-year-old economist, Algirdas Shemeta, met little objections from the majority Homeland Union party but he said it is too early to speak of his agreeing to become the new finance minister.
- U.S. CME denies that it is to buy the LNK TV channel in Lithuania but Agricultural Bank's officials say the negotiations are going on.
- Mazeikiu Nafta is expected to sign a contract with CSFB to acquire a $40 million FRN issue registered in the Securities comission on February 7.
